history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V3 decision and adds the existing owned fixed-width SIMD runner as one versioned family. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Moves wasm_simd from deferred to scored rows using the existing integer i32x4 export and its same-module scalar checksum oracle. The structural variant reverses JavaScript invocation order without changing the Wasm export or input multiset.

implemented_families_append.surface: owned fixed-width i32x4 WebAssembly arithmetic with an equivalent scalar export in the same module
implemented_families_append.oracle: The same embedded module exports integer_scalar; the existing Wasm SIMD harness rejects SIMD/scalar and cross-engine checksum disagreement before publication.
implemented_families_append.anti_specialization: Base traverses jobs in ascending order; the variant uses a distinct wrapper, identifiers, loop condition, accumulator, and descending order over the identical per-job SIMD inputs. Both call the same i32x4 export and must retain equal tier attribution.
